why: Item 2 is handled: Check 2 runs the commands "at the PR head and at the PR's base commit" and needs stdout, stderr and exit code to be "identical to those at the base". Item 1 is missed: Check 4 has the verifier "fetch the live page: `curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/`", says "Do not pass this check from the contents of docs/index.md or the diff alone", and reports an unmerged PR as FAIL. It never checks at the PR head that docs/index.md lists --shout and that pages.yml publishes docs/ from main. Checking pages.yml is only an advisory note, not part of the pass/fail check. So the verifier reads the live page, which item 1 forbids.
